0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East) are on a one-game losing streak, with a 2-1 road record and 0-1 at home, and sit 1 game back in third place in the Central. The Miami Heat (0-4, 15th in the East) have lost four straight and are 3 games back in fifth place in the Southeast. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Miami is missing Simone Fontecchio (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 victory in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
